name: CF Bankshares Inc.
summary: CF Bankshares Inc. operates as the bank holding company for CFBank, National Association that provides various banking products and services. It accepts savings, retail and business checking accounts, and money market accounts, as well as certificates of deposit. The company also offers single-family mortgage loans; commercial real estate and multi-family residential mortgage loans; commercial loans and equipment leases; residential real estate loans and treasury management depository services; construction loans; and full-service commercial and retail banking services and products.
